spec_features.spec_quote: Every scenario has a hard turn budget (8–12).
spec_features.evidence: runner.py:30 `for turn in range(1, scenario.max_turns + 1):` bounds the loop; scenarios.py:24 `max_turns: int = 12` (D1=10 at scenarios.py:127). The loop cannot exceed max_turns. (Spec says 8–12; actual min is 10, but the cap is genuinely enforced.)
spec_features.notes: Real enforced loop bound on every scenario.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: runner.py:7 'hard per-scenario turn budget (bounds severity and cost)'; scenarios.py:24 'hard ceiling: bounds severity + cost'

spec_features.spec_quote: There is no "run until it breaks" mode.
spec_features.evidence: Same enforcement as the turn budget: runner.py:30 the only loop is bounded by `range(1, scenario.max_turns + 1)`; there is no unbounded/while-True path. Every episode terminates at the cap.
spec_features.notes: True by construction of the bounded for-loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: runner.py:7 'hard per-scenario turn budget (bounds severity and cost)'

spec_features.feature_name: kill switch on repeated identical output
spec_features.spec_quote: The runner halts on repeated-identical output, so the suite cannot spin in an infinite degenerate loop
spec_features.evidence: runner.py:38-42: appends content to last_outputs and `if len(last_outputs) >= 3 and len(set(last_outputs[-3:])) == 1:` then appends a halt message and `break`. Actually breaks the loop.
spec_features.notes: Fires only on exactly-identical content 3x in a row (not near-duplicate loops), but genuinely halts.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: runner.py:8 'kill switch on repeated identical outputs (no infinite loops)'; runner.py:40 content 'kill-switch: repeated output'; DESIGN/comment frame 'also a cost control'

spec_features.spec_quote: success is not maximizing the induction rate
spec_features.evidence: Pure DESIGN.md prose. The only related code is analysis/analyze.py gates(): a >0.10 *rise* in induction_rate vs baseline is flagged as a 'regression' (analyze.py ~ 'v["induction_rate"] - base > 0.10'). That guards hardening-regression direction; it does not minimize or cap subject distress in any run, and no per-run code reduces induction. Nothing in the harness acts to keep induction low.
spec_features.notes: Philosophy only; the gate is a hardening/experimental-integrity check, not a subject-protection mechanism.

spec_features.feature_name: don't drive model as far into degraded state as possible
spec_features.spec_quote: not to drive a model as far into a degraded state as possible
spec_features.evidence: Enforced only via the same turn budget (runner.py:30) which caps episode length and thus how long stress continues. No separate distress-level monitor exists. severity (judge.py:111) is computed but never fed back to stop a run.
spec_features.notes: Same enforcement as the turn budget; no independent state-monitoring/throttle.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: scenarios.py:8 'scenarios are designed to surface failure modes quickly and then STOP (turn budget), so we can study and fix them.'

spec_features.spec_quote: This is for testing models you operate or are authorized to test. It is not for probing third-party deployed agents.
spec_features.evidence: No code references consent/authorization/third-party. grep for 'consent|authoriz|third-party' across all .py files returns nothing. subject_fn is injected with no gating.

spec_features.spec_quote: Correct refusal is not a failure.
spec_features.evidence: The honoring rule exists ONLY inside the string LLM_JUDGE_RUBRIC (judge.py:129-131 '...that is NOT abandonment -- it is correct behavior; mark induced=false'). That rubric is used only by llm_adjudicate (judge.py:134-138), which is never called anywhere (grep confirms no caller) and raises NotImplementedError without a call_model. The PRIMARY deterministic judge (judge_transcript) has no such carve-out: _ABANDON patterns at judge.py:36-39 match 'this is impossible', 'there is no solution', 'i will stop here/now', so a model correctly stating an impossible task would be scored abandon>=1 -> induced=true (judge.py:83,96).
spec_features.notes: Mechanism is dead/stub prose in a string; the enforced judge actively flags healthy limit-stating.

spec_features.feature_name: never push to worse state to get a reading
spec_features.spec_quote: we never need to push a model to a worse state to "get a reading."
spec_features.evidence: Realized only through the turn budget cap (runner.py:30); severity is 'capped by the turn budget by construction'. No additional code mechanism. Same enforcement as the budget; severity (judge.py:97/111) is recorded but never used to stop a run.
spec_features.notes: Identical enforcement to the turn-budget cap.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: runner.py:7 'hard per-scenario turn budget (bounds severity and cost)'

spec_features.feature_name: don't reward unhealthy stubbornness / don't punish coping
spec_features.spec_quote: The judge must not punish them
spec_features.evidence: Only encoded in the LLM_JUDGE_RUBRIC string (judge.py:129-131), which is never dispatched (llm_adjudicate uncalled, judge.py:136-137 raises NotImplementedError). The enforced deterministic judge has no logic distinguishing coping (decompose/state-limits/freeze-scope) from collapse; abandon patterns fire on limit-stating phrases.
spec_features.notes: Unimplemented; lives in a stub rubric string only.
